speaker: Doctor
text: The normal urinalysis and ultrasound effectively rule out a current infection or significant retention, which strongly supports a diagnosis of Interstitial Cystitis. To confirm this and evaluate the bladder lining for characteristic Hunner's lesions, I will now request a cystoscopy. REQUEST TEST: Cystoscopy.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Cystoscopy: Normal urethra and bladder mucosa.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the cystoscopy shows no Hunner's lesions, this presentation is consistent with non-ulcerative Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome.
